title: docker入门笔记
content: docker安装centos安装过程删除软件包 yum remove docker \ docker-client \ docker-client-latest \ docker-common \ docker-latest \ docker-latest-logrotate \ docker-logrotate \ docker-selinux \ docker-engine-selinux \ docker-engine 安装依赖包 yum install -y yum-utils \ device-mapper-persistent-data \ lvm2 添加yum源 # step 1: 安装必要的一些系统工具yum install -y yum-utils device-mapper-persistent-data lvm2# Step 2: 添加软件源信息yum-config-manager --add-repo http://mirrors.aliyun.com/docker-ce/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo# Step 3: 更新并安装 Docker-CEyum makecache fast 安装 yum install docker-ce# 安装命令补全yum install title: Hello World
content: Welcome to Hexo! This is your very first post. Check documentation for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in troubleshooting or you can ask me on GitHub. Quick StartCreate a new post$ hexo new My New Post More info: Writing Run server$ hexo server More info: Server Generate static files$ hexo generate More info: Generating Deploy to remote sites$ hexo deploy More info: Deployment
